scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: TRUE — 'ninjurytime' is explicitly listed in trial_measured_features so the proposed modifier was recorded in this dataset. G2: FALSE — the provided mechanism statements are epidemiological (baseline cardiovascular risk, baseline disease burden, absolute-risk/trajectory arguments) and do not name any concrete biological steps (e.g., fibrinolysis, plasminogen/plasmin inhibition by TXA, PK changes) that would mechanistically link ninjurytime to differential drug action; cascade: G3..G5 also FALSE. G3: FALSE — because G2 failed, and the hypotheses as presented do not claim a specific PD/PK or pathophysiologic difference (they amount to baseline-risk amplification or vague interaction claims) that would make TXA act differently in subgroups. G4: FALSE — cascade: G4 is false because no specific mechanistic interaction was proposed to check against literature and the provided items are labeled hypothesis-generating without citation of mechanistic evidence. G5: FALSE — cascade: G5 is false because the hypothesis descriptions are vague (no mechanistic cut-points or actionable biologic markers) and therefore do not define operational subgroups for clinical decision-making.
scored_features.justification: Decisive gate: G2 failed because the submitted hypotheses only state epidemiological/absolute-risk arguments and do not specify any concrete biological pathway (receptor/enzyme/PK-PD) by which time-from-injury would alter tranexamic acid's effect; therefore later gates cannot be passed.
